say:1:1033433001:1.text: The Lucent Tree, planted by Misarte herself, was corrupted all because of Eomir... the one we supported.
say:1:1033433001:1.source_cn: 可弥萨忒亲手种下的流荧树，确实是因为荆棘……因为我们所...
say:1:1033433001:1.male: The Lucent Tree, planted by Misarte herself, was corrupted all because of Eomir... the one we supported.
say:1:1033433001:1.female: The Lucent Tree, planted by Misarte herself, was corrupted all because of Eomir... the one we supported.

say:2:1033433002:1.text: The Thorned Guards are meant to be the swords that eradicate threats within the forest, but we've ended up slashing at the holy tree.
say:2:1033433002:1.source_cn: 荆棘作为守护丛林的利刃，最终却刺向了庇护薄暮丛林的圣树。
